rubric.statement: The program constructs two `dspy.Signature` types whose field names and field metadata match, while only the `answer` output annotation differs between `int` and `str`.
It inspects the output field metadata and verifies at runtime that the two `answer` fields really carry different annotations (`int` versus `str`).
It verifies that calling `.equals` on those two signatures returns `True`, demonstrating that an annotation-only change does not affect `Signature.equals`.

It keeps the signatures' instructions identical, either explicitly or by relying on the shared default instructions derived from the same field names, so the equality result isolates the type-only change.
